about.title: Our story
about.seo_desc: Why Somnila exists: a founder who kept waking up stiff, and the pillow he went looking for. Memory foam that holds, covers you can wash, 30 nights to decide.
about.body:
I kept waking up stiff.

Not every morning. Enough of them. I went looking for a pillow I would actually want to keep, and found three kinds: the blue hospital kind, the overpriced kind, and the kind that goes flat in three months. Sometimes all three at once.

Most people sleep badly and accept it. I didn't want to.

So I built the pillow I was looking for. Shaped around the way a body actually lies, made of foam that holds, with a cover you can wash. Priced like an object you keep, not a gadget you replace.

Try it for thirty nights. If it isn't right, send us an email and we refund it.

What Somnila is

A small range, named like objects: Neck 01, Contour 01, Side 01, Body 01, Lounge 01. Each one has a job, a height and a shape, and nothing else. No gadgets, no glowing claims, no permanent sale.

What it isn't

Somnila is not a medical product and we don't give medical advice. We make pillows that hold a position comfortably. What you do with a better night is yours.

Start with Neck 01

shipping-delivery.title: Shipping & delivery
shipping-delivery.seo_desc: Somnila ships tracked to the US, Canada, the UK, Europe and Australia in 6–10 days. Free shipping on every pillow.
shipping-delivery.body:
Every order ships tracked. You get the tracking number by email as soon as the parcel leaves.

Delivery times

Canada6–10 daysFree on every pillow · €7.90 on accessories alone

Rest of the world6–10 days€14.90

Prices are shown in your local currency at checkout. Free shipping applies to every order from €54.90, which is the price of our least expensive pillow: every pillow and every set ships free. Only accessories bought on their own (mask, earplugs, covers, throw) pay shipping.

Where the parcel comes from

Pillows are made and packed by our manufacturing partner and shipped directly to you, which is how we keep the price of a memory-foam pillow where it is. Delivery times are counted from the day the parcel leaves.

Customs and taxes

Where duties or import taxes apply to your country, they are calculated at checkout when possible. If your local carrier asks for a payment on delivery, write to us with the receipt and we will sort it out.

A parcel that arrives damaged

Take a photo of the box and the product before unpacking further, and write to us within 3 days of delivery. We replace or refund.

returns-warranty.title: Returns & 30-night trial
returns-warranty.seo_desc: Sleep on any Somnila pillow for 30 nights. If it isn't right, email us and we refund it. How the trial, returns and warranty work.
returns-warranty.body:
The 30-night trial

A pillow can only be judged in bed, on your nights. So every Somnila pillow (Neck 01, Contour 01, Side 01, Body 01, Lounge 01) and every set that contains one comes with a 30-night trial, counted from the day it is delivered.

If it isn't right, send us an email within those 30 nights with your order number. We refund the price of the pillow to the payment method you used. No form, no questions beyond what would help us make a better pillow. You don't need to send the pillow back.

Accessories

Mask 01, Quiet 01, covers and Throw 01 are hygiene and textile items. They can be returned unused, in their packaging, within 14 days of delivery for a refund. Write to us first and we send the return instructions.

Defects

If a product arrives damaged or a defect appears in normal use, write to us with a photo and your order number. We replace it or refund it. This does not limit your statutory rights, for example the two-year legal guarantee of conformity in the European Union.

Refund timing

Refunds are issued as soon as we confirm the request by email. Depending on your bank, the amount appears on your statement within 5 to 10 business days.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.seo_desc: Answers about Somnila pillows: heights, covers, care, delivery in 6–10 days, the 30-night trial and returns.
faq.body:
Choosing

Which pillow is for me?

Neck 01 is the one most people start with: two heights (13 cm and 11 cm), one on each side, so you pick the one that fits the way you lie. Contour 01 is lower and softer (10 cm), for people who like a pillow that gives more. Side 01 is made for side sleepers who want a firmer 10 cm profile. Body 01 is a 120 cm body pillow that goes between the knees and along the back. Lounge 01 is for reading in bed, not for sleeping on.

Which height should I choose on Neck 01?

Both are on the same pillow. Lie on the 13 cm side first: if your head tilts up, turn the pillow to the 11 cm side. Most people know after two nights.

What is the pillow made of?

Memory foam, with a removable cover included. The Neck 01 and Contour 01 covers have a cool-touch surface. Dimensions, weight and materials are listed on every product page in centimetres and inches.

Using it

How long does it take to get used to it?

A contoured pillow holds your head differently from a flat one, so give it a few nights. That is exactly what the 30-night trial is for.

Can I wash the cover?

Yes. Unzip it and machine wash it cold on a gentle cycle, then let it dry flat. The foam itself should not go in the machine; a damp cloth is enough.

Does the foam have a smell when new?

New foam can have a light smell for the first hours. Leave the pillow uncovered in a ventilated room for half a day before the first night.

Ordering

How long does delivery take?

6 to 10 days, tracked, to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Europe and Australia. Details on the shipping page.

Is shipping free?

On every pillow and every set, yes. Only accessories bought on their own pay shipping.

What if it isn't right for me?

Email us within 30 nights of delivery and we refund the pillow. See returns and the 30-night trial.

In which currency do I pay?

In your local currency, converted at checkout: US dollars, Canadian dollars, pounds, euros, Australian dollars and others.
